mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, thus negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals an increase in economic output, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month, it signals a strong demand environment coupled with a tightening labor market, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it indicates a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs increase.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last three months signals strong job growth, which is likely to boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month, it signals a robust economic environment, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
